# dsh-jev-mcp
[](https://github.com/NingYuanLee/dsh-jev-mcp/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [](https://www.npmjs.com/pac
kage/dsh-jev-mcp) [](LICENSE) [](#compatibility) [](#compatibility) [](https://github.com/topics/dsh
-plugin) [](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
> Third-party community plugin for DeepSeek Harness. Not an official DeepSeek or TypeSafe product. M
y community plugin for DeepSeek Harness. Not an official DeepSeek or TypeSafe product. MIT licensed.
English | 中文
Runs @jkudish/jev-mcp inside DeepSeek Harness and registers the judgment tools that server publishes
. They show up as `mcp__jev__*`. Jev answers typed questions (verify, screen, find, rerank, classify
, decide, compare, extract, audit, review, gate, noul). It does not chat and it is not a replacement
for the model running the agent. See Jev with coding agents.
## What it does
The agent can call Jev without a separate MCP config. The plugin reads an API key from the DSH crede
ntial store, starts the pinned `@jkudish/jev-mcp` package on stdio with `node`, and hands that proce
ss to `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client`. The key is not stored in `cordis.patch.yml` and is not placed o
/dsh-mcp-client`. The key is not stored in `cordis.patch.yml` and is not placed on the command line.
It also registers a `jev` skill so the agent loads the call conventions before using the tools. In t
his host the raw names are prefixed: `jev_verify` is `mcp__jev__jev_verify`.
If the credential is empty, the plugin stays loaded, the skill stays available, and no Jev tools are
registered. Saving the credential reconnects.
## How it works
1. Register the bundled `jev` skill on `ctx.skills`. A user or project skill with the same name stil

l wins.
2. Resolve the selected provider’s credential through `ctx.credentials` (TypeSafe defaults t
o `TYPESAFE_API_KEY`). Only the credential-store value is accepted; process and .env fallbacks are i

gnored.
3. Resolve `@jkudish/jev-mcp`'s `bin` (`dist/index.js` in 0.14.7) and spawn it with `process
.execPath`. The child receives the selected provider’s credential, `JEV_PROVIDER`, and `JEV_MCP_MODE

L`.
4. Mount one `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` child with `transport: stdio`. Tool names, schemas, a

nd results come from the server. This package does not reimplement them.
5. When `credentials/refere
nce-updated` fires for the same credential name, dispose that child and connect again.
Each tool call times out after 2 minutes. A dropped connection uses the MCP client's own reconnect p
olicy. The stdio client probes once before the serving process; that second process is the harness,
client probes once before the serving process; that second process is the harness, not this package.

Create a key at the TypeSafe console, then enter the key and model ID under Settings → Jev model. Th

## Configuration
| Field | Default | Meaning |

| `apiKeyEnv` | `TYPESAFE_API_KEY` | Credential reference. The value is not kept in this config. |
|
`serverName` | `jev` | Namespace for tool names: `mcp__<serverName>__<tool>`. Must match `[A-Za-z0-

9_-]{1,32}` and be unique among MCP clients in the same scope. |
| `model` | `jev-latest` | Passed a

s `JEV_MCP_MODEL`. Use a name from `GET /v1/models`, such as `jev-1.14`. |
| `baseURL` | empty | Opt
ional TypeSafe origin only (`https://api.typesafe.ai`). The SDK appends the route. No user info, pat
h, query, or fragment. |
Example profile override. A later patch replaces the whole `config` object, so repeat every field yo
le override. A later patch replaces the whole `config` object, so repeat every field you still want:

The Cordis row id is `jev-mcp`. The package name is `dsh-jev-mcp`.
TypeSafe, OpenRouter, Cloudflare Workers AI, Vercel AI Gateway, and compatible System One endpoints
are supported. Keys are stored separately; Cloudflare requires an account ID, compatible services re
quire a full endpoint URL, and Vercel supports optional zero-data-retention routing. Ambient keys ma
tching `KEY`, `TOKEN`, `SECRET`, or `PASSWORD` are scrubbed by the MCP client before the explicit en
`TOKEN`, `SECRET`, or `PASSWORD` are scrubbed by the MCP client before the explicit env is applied.
## Security

- The key is passed only through the selected provider’s child environment variable.
- The child sen

ds the key and judgment text to the selected provider or configured endpoint.
- This plugin's own lo

g lines do not print the key. Do not paste the key into chat.
- The plugin does not read `$DSH_HOME/
.credentials.yaml` itself.
See SECURITY.md.
## Compatibility
| Item | Value |

`0.2.2-rc.1` |
| Jev MCP | `@jkudish/jev-mcp@0.14.7` |
| Requires | `credentials`, `tools`, `skills
`, and the shipped `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` |
Display metadata is `locale/en.json`, `locale/zh.json`, and `icon.svg`. The plugin settings panel pr
ovides model and API key configuration.
## Uninstall
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Removing the plugin stops the MCP process and unregisters its tools and the bundled skill. It does n
ot delete saved provider credentials. Nothing else is stored on disk by this package.
